query: unemployment benefit scheme still valid eligibility revisions

items.content:
# Unemployment support schemes

Unemployment benefit scheme still valid eligibility revisions: the Employees State Insurance Corporation runs an unemployment allowance for insured persons (Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana), paying a share of average wages for a limited period after involuntary job loss, with contribution-history eligibility. Scheme terms, relaxations and sunset dates have been revised; verify with ESIC before relying on it. Provident fund partial withdrawal after job loss is a separate income smoothing option.

# Public Provident Fund and small savings

PPF guaranteed return small savings: Public Provident Fund has a 15 year tenure, deposits of Rs 500 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year, sovereign guaranteed return, and qualifies for Section 80C tax saving under the old regime. The rate is notified by the Government of India every quarter. Recent changes revisions small savings scheme rate: quarterly notifications can hold, raise or cut rates; always check the latest Ministry of Finance notification. Partial withdrawal allowed from the 7th financial year.
